summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season, which kicks off in just one week! The squad has been strengthened with several fantastic new signings and at least one returning player, plus the club is sporting three brand new kits. In their final pre-season outing against St Helens, it was a closely contested match where St Helens' clinical finishing made the difference, but the Ramblers will be looking to bounce back as they begin their promotion push.
